name: Trochlear Dysplasia
definition: Abnormal shallow or misshapen femoral trochlea that predisposes to recurrent lateral patellar instability.

investigations.principle: True lateral radiographs and MRI/CT characterize trochlear morphology and associated risk factors.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, cartilage, ligament or occult injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Severe dysplasia in recurrent instability may influence surgical planning, including trochleoplasty in selected patients.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Sandhi structural phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Abnormal shallow or misshapen femoral trochlea that predisposes to recurrent lateral patellar instability.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, unreduced dislocation, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
